scientific_integrity: Proof and exact algebra are supplied in RESULT.md. Standalone checker.py arithmetically tests symbolic identities with rational arithmetic and samples numerical regimes; finite tests do not prove the infinite-domain theorem. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Mathematical optimization of the average instantaneous Haldane–Andrews response under an externally imposed substrate concentration law with fixed mean and optionally a finite upper cap. The occupation law need not be implementable in a mass-balanced chemostat. It does not establish stability, maximum production yield, feed-rate feasibility, or empirical predictive accuracy. Historical priority is provisional because some older potentially related full texts were inaccessible.
title: A sharp mean–cap phase diagram for Haldane substrate-inhibited growth
